summary: Western-themed real-time tactics series about John Cooper and his crew, from Spellbound's early PC stealth tactics games to Mimimi's 2020 prequel.

entries.title: Desperados: Wanted Dead or Alive

emulation.notes: No emulation needed for the modernized PC release.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original PC presentation with modern compatibility support.

primary.why: The Windows modernized release preserves the original game while adding current-system compatibility and the restored demo mission; Mac and Linux support are useful but have no exclusive content.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows Steam/GOG version after the 2018 modernized update; apply fixes if any display or compatibility tuning is needed.

entries.remaster_caveats: The 2018 update improves compatibility rather than remaking the visuals or design.

entries.title: Desperados 2: Cooper's Revenge

emulation.notes: No emulation needed, but legacy Windows components may be required.

primary.why: Cooper's Revenge is Windows-only, so the PC version is the only and complete route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows PC release through Steam/GOG or another legitimate storefront, with DirectPlay/compatibility fixes if needed.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster; older Windows dependencies may need compatibility fixes.

entries.title: Helldorado

emulation.notes: No emulation needed, but compatibility fixes may be required.

primary.why: Helldorado is the Windows-only stand-alone continuation of Desperados 2, making the PC release the only complete route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows PC release after Desperados 2 if following the Spellbound-era story.

entries.remaster_caveats: Originally conceived as an expansion but released as a stand-alone continuation; no remaster.

entries.title: Desperados III
entries.definitive_edition: Windows PC version with Money for the Vultures DLC

primary.version: Windows PC release with Money for the Vultures DLC
primary.why: Windows offers the highest-fidelity version, mouse/keyboard tactics controls, and easy access to the full DLC set; console, Mac, and Linux releases have no documented exclusive content.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows PC version and include the three Money for the Vultures DLC missions for complete story coverage.

entries.remaster_caveats: Prequel/revival by Mimimi rather than a remake of the earlier games.
